topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I just got a call from my best friend, Alex. They said the plans for this weekend had to change. Apparently, the place we were supposed to meet is closed for renovations. It's a real shame, too, because I was looking forward to it so much. Had a new outfit picked out and everything. Maybe we can try another time. I guess I'll just stay in and maybe watch a movie or something instead. Oh well, can't be helped.
